arguments.code: async ({ shell: { exec } }) => exec("git status --short; grep -n -i -A3 'releas' CONTRIBUTING.md | head -60; ls .github/workflows; gh pr view 83 --json state,mergeable,statusCheckRollup -q '{state:.state,mergeable:.mergeable,checks:[.statusCheckRollup[]|{n:.name,s:.status,c:.conclusion}]}'; gh pr list --state all --search 'release' --limit 3 --json number,title,headRefName,state")
arguments.label: Check release process docs and PR state
